mapper.select: SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND action=#{action} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id

SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND action IN ('member.manage','project.grant') AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='ID-09' AND idempotency_key=#{key}
SELECT tenant_id,member_id,user_id,status,valid_from,valid_to,revision FROM tenant_member m WHERE user_id=#{targetId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id,identity_id,mode,issuer,subject,local_user_id,status FROM identity_binding i WHERE user_id=#{targetId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id,identity_id,mode,issuer,subject,local_user_id,status FROM identity_binding i WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant g WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT version_id,owner_project_id,content_sha256 FROM version_registry v WHERE version_id=#{versionId}
SELECT status FROM project p WHERE project_id=#{projectId} FOR UPDATE

choose.when: SELECT tenant_id AS id,NULL AS project_id FROM tenant r WHERE tenant_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT project_id AS id,project_id FROM project r WHERE project_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT member_id AS id,NULL AS project_id FROM tenant_member r WHERE member_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT source_id AS id,owner_project_id AS project_id FROM source r WHERE source_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT task_id AS id,project_id FROM task_head r WHERE task_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT document_id AS id,project_id FROM document_head r WHERE document_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT artifact_id AS id,project_id FROM artifact r WHERE artifact_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT config_id AS id,project_id FROM configuration_head r WHERE config_id=#{resourceId} UNION ALL SELECT policy_id AS id,project_id FROM agent_execution_policy_version WHERE policy_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT template_version AS id,NULL AS project_id FROM template_version r WHERE template_version=#{resourceId}
SELECT rule_version AS id,NULL AS project_id FROM rule_version r WHERE rule_version=#{resourceId}
SELECT budget_id AS id,project_id FROM budget_account r WHERE budget_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT evaluation_id AS id,project_id FROM evaluation_batch r WHERE evaluation_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT audit_id AS id,project_id FROM audit_event r WHERE audit_id=#{resourceId}
SELECT report_id AS id,project_id FROM report_export r WHERE report_id=#{resourceId}

mapper.update: UPDATE permission_grant SET status='REVOKED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} AND subject_id=#{targetId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE tenant_member SET status='DISABLED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND user_id=#{targetId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status IN ('ACTIVE','INVITED')
UPDATE permission_grant SET status='REVOKED',revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE subject_id=#{targetId} AND status='ACTIVE'

UPDATE member_invitation SET status=CASE WHEN expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'REVOKED' END, terminal_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),terminal_reason=#{reason},revision=revision+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE user_id=#{targetId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE tenant SET auth_epoch=auth_epoch+1 WHERE auth_epoch=#{epoch}
